# Atomic Constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AtomicConstraint>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A single ODRL constraint comparison: a [`gmeow:leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) (the dimension tested), a [`gmeow:constraintOperator`](../properties/gmeow-constraintOperator.md) (the comparison), and a [`gmeow:rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) (the value). E.g. [`leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) dateTime, operator lteq, [`rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) 2030-01-01 — 'valid until 2030'.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a single rule-condition comparison — a dimension, an operator, and a value (dateTime ≤ 2030, spatial = EU, count ≤ 5) — the leaf of the ODRL constraint algebra.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a boolean combination of several conditions (use [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md)) and avoid splitting one comparison across triples; an atomic constraint carries exactly one operand/operator/value triple.

### How to use

- Mint one [`AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md), set [`gmeow:leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) and [`gmeow:constraintOperator`](../properties/gmeow-constraintOperator.md) to values and [`gmeow:rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) (or [`gmeow:rightOperandReference`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperandReference.md) for an IRI) to the tested value, and attach it with [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](../properties/gmeow-ruleConstraint.md).

### Examples

- ex:until2030 a [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md); [`gmeow:leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) [`gmeow:leftOpDateTime`](../individuals/gmeow-leftOpDateTime.md); [`gmeow:constraintOperator`](../properties/gmeow-constraintOperator.md) [`gmeow:operatorLteq`](../individuals/gmeow-operatorLteq.md); [`gmeow:rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) "2030-01-01".
